result.summary: The interface displays several minor visual issues related to layout clipping and content placeholders.

issues.description: Horizontal category chips and restaurant names like 'Trattoria Piccol...' are truncated abruptly.
issues.suggestion: Implement text wrapping or horizontal fading effects to indicate more content is available.

issues.description: Generic vector illustrations are used instead of actual food photography for all restaurant listings.
issues.suggestion: Populate the cards with high-quality food imagery to improve user trust and engagement.

issues.description: Text clipping occurs on the 'Tokumaru Ramen' title, cutting off the final characters.
issues.suggestion: Adjust text containers or font sizes to ensure complete brand names are legible.
